description: A visa does not guarantee entry. Admissibility is determined at the port of entry by an officer, whose decision there is not subject to appeal.
energy_note: The visa was never a promise.

aspect: Withdrawal of application is offered as the kind option
description: Rather than a formal refusal, he may be offered the chance to withdraw his application for admission - which avoids a removal on his record and is also an agreement not to contest anything.
energy_note: Offered the merciful version, which is also a waiver.

aspect: Expedited removal leaves a five-year bar
description: The alternative to withdrawal can be expedited removal, carrying a bar on return, decided by an officer without a judge.
energy_note: Five years, decided at a counter.

description: Four hours at the bridge. The officer offers him a form: sign, go home, no removal on the record. Or contest it, and risk a five-year bar. He signs. The visa in his passport is still valid and still worth nothing.
energy_note: A valid visa, and a signature saying he withdraws.
